name: F1/tiebreak-id
description: Tie-break #3: lexicographically smallest id wins. When intent and witness counts tie, the smaller id wins.
rule: spec §5.2 tie-break: smallest id (by Unicode code point) first
_note: Both task-a and task-b are in task-c's ancestry with the same value and the same witness/intent counts. task-a should win by tie-break #3 (smaller id).
